MORE RULES & GAME MODES

THE BASICS

Move with the left stick or WASD. Punch is fast. Heavy has a visible wind-up and knocks rivals down. Kick has longer reach and damages legs. Attacks must connect: being close is not an automatic hit.

GRAB / COUNTER

Tap Grab beside a rival, then tap again to throw them down. Tap it out of grab range to prepare a short counter. A melee strike landing during its first 0.30 seconds is returned. If grabbed, tap Grab repeatedly to escape.

PROPS & DODGES

Move beside a highlighted prop and tap Pick Up. Tap again to throw toward the nearest rival. Holding a prop occupies your hands. Dodge uses your movement direction, grants brief protection and costs stamina.

THE CHAOS CLOUD

Three or more nearby fighters and recent attacks start a brawl cloud. Their HP, attack timing, injuries and positions remain real. Heads pop out after impacts. Move or dodge out: the cloud is not a trap or a random-damage cutscene.

INJURIES MATTER

Below 75 HP: bruised. Below 50: beat up. Below 25: wrecked. Repeated head hits leave black eyes. Leg damage causes a visible limp and slows movement. Getting up grants temporary protection. At zero HP, you're out.

THREE WAYS TO WIN

Last One: eliminate all three rivals. Score Brawl: most points in 90 seconds, with respawns. The Crown: hold it for 45 accumulated seconds; knockdowns drop it. Incoming damage fills Rage for your next powered-up attack.

Fictional, non-graphic slapstick. One local human player plus three AI opponents. No online multiplayer or split-screen in this build.
